task.title: Test offline navigation feasibility
task.intent: Determine whether the existing navigation shell can preserve the last opened screen without adding a new state subsystem.

result: A disposable prototype preserved the last screen through the existing router state; a separate persistence service was unnecessary for the tested session boundary.

evidence.result: The router restored the last screen after the simulated reconnect.
Documented restoration behavior is limited to the current application session.

discarded: A new persistence service was not earned by the tested session-scoped requirement.
uncertainty: Cold-launch restoration has not been tested.
next_decision: Decide whether cold-launch restoration is a current product requirement.
